topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The rain's coming down in sheets, blurring the lines between the gutter and the side of the road. A guy, claims he's stumbled onto a time capsule. Not just any old trinkets, he's telling me. supposedly buried in a patch of his backyard he hasn't so much as glanced at in years. Figures, right? That sort of thing, it doesn't just happen to anybody. It's the kind of luck that makes you wonder what else is lurking out there, waiting to be unearthed. Could be nothing, could be something that’s better left forgotten. I’m gonna need to see this for myself, get a feel for the story. The kind of story that's got more layers than a cheap knockoff trench coat. Better keep an eye on this one.
